messages.content: Independent enterprise predeployment rubric for exact SHA 577d5817c30baa4ed969b8af9de500e698d67159. P means PASS and F means FAIL. Mark F only for a concrete unresolved material defect in that category. Deployment itself and a live paid provider smoke are next separately gated operations, so do not fail solely because no credential or paid request is present. Output schema JSON only.

Exact V9 candidate adds a server-side Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 text-to-video adapter and durable asynchronous provider execution gateway. No provider credential is configured in the current production runtime and validation made no paid provider request. Production must report Higgsfield as CREDENTIAL_REQUIRED until an encrypted KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET credential is stored. Every credit-bearing request is gated by an authenticated owner/admin approval whose scope hash binds job_id, job_revision, provider, model, request SHA, prompt SHA, exact input hashes and the catalog estimate. Changing any bound input invalidates the approval. A durable generation attempt is written as SUBMISSION_PENDING before POST; a process loss or ambiguous submit without request_id fails closed and is never blindly resubmitted. Once request_id is persisted, restart recovery polls the same request. Crash-after-output-collection recovery reuses the SHA-bound artifact without a second provider request. Provider lifecycle telemetry is stored separately from Graph workflow progress. Higgsfield documented statuses queued/in_progress/completed/failed/nsfw are shown; numeric provider percent is always null because the provider contract does not document an authoritative render percentage. Reference/mascot scenes fail closed with PROVIDER_REFERENCE_UPLOAD_REQUIRED and do not silently degrade to text-only generation. failed/nsfw terminal states require reviewed recovery and do not auto-spend again. Output collection accepts only bounded HTTPS media, rejects private/reserved literal and DNS-resolved addresses, manually validates redirects, enforces timeout/size/MIME bounds, hashes exact bytes and preserves provenance. Existing human Critic, independent verifier and release gates remain unchanged. The encrypted integration vault remains server-side and provider discovery never returns secrets. package.json, pnpm-lock, Docker/Compose, authentication, signer and deployment trust-root code are unchanged. Exact evidence for SHA 577d5817c30baa4ed969b8af9de500e698d67159: full suite 198 discovered / 197 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; V9/core targeted 26/26 PASS; typecheck PASS; production build PASS; contracts 13/13 PASS; production dependency audit has no known vulnerabilities. Clean exact browser E2E PASS including separate provider status vs Graph percent and explicit paid-spend approval UI. Clean exact FIRMES non-test completion E2E PASS. Detached exact worktree verifier: 38/38 PASS plus typecheck/build/contracts/audit PASS. Runtime package 1481 files, 0 forbidden entries, 0 external symlinks, manifest 508de2dd882c91021ab55c0181aaae4529943c83c5dad28e807bc3628644de0e, production-source SHA 9d1afba0ebfbb994dd1ef6b04b9926d09a7678ad7c12381301b7d5bcfdec59fe. The first browser V9 fixture attempt failed only because the test interceptor matched the GET job endpoint but not its /approve-provider-spend child route; the test fixture was corrected in a test-only commit and the clean exact browser journey then passed. Current public V8 baseline c29dd79 is converged with public health and process recovery PASS. Signed V9 deployment is the next release step. A live paid smoke test is deliberately not claimed and remains separately gated on an actual Media Factory server credential plus explicit spend approval.
